title: Revoke, Never Approve
brief: After a phishing scare, the security lead wants the Safe to stop granting USDC approvals. Old approvals must still be revocable. The team keeps its permissive catch-all for everything else, for now.

rules.note: Allows every CALL without its own rule

hints: An exact rule on approve for USDC wins over the catch-all.
DenyPolicy refuses revokes too: it never looks at the amount.
The spender allowlist always lets an approval of zero through. What does it allow with nobody on the list?
explain: The spender allowlist always lets an approval of zero through, whoever the spender. With nobody on the list, that is all it allows: revokes pass, new approvals do not. DenyPolicy would have blocked the revokes too, leaving old approvals stuck in place.
